mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat ( study_id, member_id, message, send_at ) VALUES ( #{studyId}, #{memberId}, #{message}, #{sendAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.study_id, c.member_id, m.nickname, c.message, c.send_at FROM chat c JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.study_id = #{studyId} ORDER BY c.send_at ASC
